Xiaomi 18 Pro and Xiaomi 18 Pro Max launched with a back display
 The Xiaomi 18 Pro series continues to bring Leica-tuned lenses in the flagship phones, while running on the latest chipsets from Qualcomm
 Published - November 18, 2026 03:32 pm IST 
 The Hindu Bureau READ LATER 
 SEE ALL 
 Remove 
 Xiaomi 18 Pro and Xiaomi 18 Pro Max launched with a back display
 | Photo Credit: Special Arrangement
 Xiaomi has launched its new flagship smartphones, the Xiaomi 18 Pro and Xiaomi 18 Pro Max , in a global unveil. The Xiaomi 18 Pro series features a back display that can be used to view notification and can also act as a viewfinder.
 The Xiaomi 18 Pro series continues to bring Leica-tuned lenses in the flagship phones, while running on the latest chipsets from Qualcomm.
 Xiaomi 18 Pro Max has a 6.9 inch LTPO AMOLED display with a dynamic refresh rate up to 120 Hz, 4,000 nits peak brightness, supporting Dolby Vision and HDR10+. The Xiaomi 18 Pro gets a 6.4 inch display with similar refresh rate and brightness.
 Xiaomi has also introduced a privacy mode like Samsung, which reduces pixels brightness if viewed from sides to avoid glancing. It can be applied to selected apps, notifications, floating windows, and split-screen views.
 The back display has up to 4,000 nits peak brightness with a 1-120 Hz LTPO refresh rate, protected by Corning Gorilla Glass Victus 2. It can also be used as a real-time translation tool that displays each speaker’s language on their respective side for face-to-face communication in 29 languages.
 Xiaomi 18 Pro Max runs on the Snapdragon 8 Elite Extreme Gen 6, while Xiaomi 18 Pro features the Snapdragon 8 Elite Gen 6 SoC. Xiaomi 18 Pro series operates on HyperOS 4 based on Android 17 out of the box.
 Xiaomi 18 Pro Max ships with a 7,050 mAh battery with 100W wired and 50W wireless HyperCharge; Xiaomi 18 Pro gets a 6,000 mAh battery with 90W wired and 50W wireless HyperCharge.
 Both, Xiaomi 18 Pro Max and Xiaomi 18 Pro sport a 200 MP main camera, a 200 MP telephoto lens, a 50 MP ultrawide sensor, along with a 50 MP selfie camera.
 Xiaomi 18 Pro Max starts at €1,599, while Xiaomi 18 Pro begins at €1,399. The series is available in Black, White, Cosmic Blue, and Velvet Red.
